title.zh: 卡 RE-2(r2)：NP5-01a A-2 归因更正/重扫 + A-2 设备级对照（policy_scan 修复说明；脚本入仓另卡；零 GPU）
title.en: Card RE-2(r2): NP5-01a A-2 attribution correction/rescan + A-2 device-level comparison (policy_scan fix notes; script landing in a separate card; zero GPU)

intent.zh: 承接原 RE-2 卡（修复流程受 normify fix/commit-钩子循环阻断，按干净点重建 r2）：第一节 A-2 addenda append r2——归因更正（历史 0 命中是分隔符漏检、非否定豁免）、policy_scan 分隔符归一化修复说明（12 条构造自测 12/12 PASS；工具源码修复版本已就绪，入仓另卡）、清单口径以 FORBIDDEN_CORES 为准、append-orderr 笔误更正；重扫 A-2 evidence 5（历史已撤回）/addenda 0；A-2 landing 字节不改、manifest 重算。第二节 A-2 设备级映射（产品 mod.rs/mass_matrix.rs 离线编译 vs 冻结 smooth.ptx；PTX 不入仓）；kinematics=not-decidable、crb=engine-semantic、mass_multiply=not-decidable（no-reference-entry）。零 GPU、零窗；不改 src/tests/fixtures/脚本内判据/参考/容差。
intent.en: Re-registered r2 of RE-2 after the fix-flow commit-hook loop blocked the original card (clean-point rebuild): section 1 A-2 addenda r2 - attribution corrected (the historical 0 hits were a separator leak, not negation exemption), policy_scan separator-normalization fix documented (12/12 constructed self-tests), forbidden-list authority, append-orderr typo; rescan A-2 evidence 5 (withdrawn historical) / addenda 0; A-2 landing bytes unchanged, manifest recomputed. Section 2 A-2 device-level mapping (offline product mod.rs/mass_matrix.rs vs frozen smooth.ptx; PTX not landed). Zero GPU/window.

acceptance: `docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a2/addenda.md` append r2 节：归因更正、policy_scan 分隔符归一化修复（12/12 自测）、清单口径以 FORBIDDEN_CORES 为准、append-orderr 笔误、重扫计数；A-2 evidence/README/receipt 字节不改，manifest 重算。

`docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-re2/`：evidence.json（policy_fix 节 + device_level 行映射）、README、receipt（policy_fix_self_tests=12、rescan_evidence_hits=5、rescan_addenda_hits=0、ptx_landed=false）、logs/selfcheck.txt、manifest；UTF-8/LF 无 BOM。
边界：写域仅 `docs/development-evidence/np-gate/**` + `.normify/**`；`unchanged src/`、`tests/`、`fixtures/`；scripts/np-gate/policy_scan.py 入仓在紧随独立小卡（源码修复版本已备 target/）；零 GPU、零窗。
四门禁 + normify check；中文提交。
note: 原 RE-2 卡（2026-11-11-np5-01a-re2-a2-device-level-policy-fix）已完成工作但提交被 normify fix/addenda 钩子循环阻断；本 r2 以干净卡重建同一交付，避免 fix 流程；policy_scan 入仓另卡。
